note: Experimental submodule of graphql_compose. Exposes core Layout Builder data (sections/components/field blocks) to the schema. Depends on graphql_compose_blocks and graphql_compose_layouts. It has no per-bundle config key of its own, so medium/hard cases are grounded in the real, restorable schema-provider registration on the server (schema_configuration.graphql_compose.providers.graphql_compose_layout_builder; baseline: absent). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries and 'drush cr'.

evals.prompt: What does graphql_compose_layout_builder expose to the GraphQL schema, and what is its stability status?
evals.expected_output: It (experimentally) exposes core Layout Builder data - a field's sections, each section's layout, and its placed components/blocks - so a decoupled client can reconstruct the page layout. It is flagged experimental and may change.

evals.prompt: Which GraphQL Compose submodules does graphql_compose_layout_builder depend on, and why?
evals.expected_output: It depends on graphql_compose_blocks (to resolve block components in sections) and graphql_compose_layouts (for layout definitions/regions), plus core layout_builder.

evals.prompt: Name some GraphQL types or data producers graphql_compose_layout_builder provides for resolving a layout.
evals.expected_output: SchemaTypes LayoutBuilderSection, LayoutBuilderComponent, LayoutBuilderInterface, BlockField, BlockFieldUnion; producers such as LayoutBuilderSections, LayoutBuilderSectionComponents and LayoutBuilderComponentRegion/Weight/Configuration.

evals.prompt: Inspect the GraphQL Compose server configuration (graphql.graphql_servers.graphql_compose_server) and state whether graphql_compose_layout_builder is currently registered in the schema providers list.

Register graphql_compose_layout_builder as a GraphQL Compose schema provider on the default server by adding it to schema_configuration.graphql_compose.providers on graphql.graphql_servers.graphql_compose_server. Apply the change to the live configuration.
